bug.title: GitHub Skill bundle reports BUNDLE_STRUCTURE_UNSUPPORTED
bug.summary: The GitHub Skill bundle structure failure is tracked independently from archive parsing, local fixtures, public GitHub, installation, and invocation claims.

steps: Use a temporary archive fixture with the reported bundle shape.
Distinguish structure rejection from install and invocation outcomes.
reproduction.observed: BUNDLE_STRUCTURE_UNSUPPORTED remains an open product claim; no public or installed Skill result is asserted.

confirmed_facts.statement: The supplied product audit records BUNDLE_STRUCTURE_UNSUPPORTED as an independent GitHub Skill bundle issue.
